newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil firms, fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil firms, fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Friday morning, gas oil gaining in line with stronger IPE futures, while fuel oil held at Thursday's closing levels.

Heating oil was over $1 a tonne firmer as IPE June futures strengthened, but premiums were steady. Offers for prompt barges held at around IPE June +$1/+$1.25 fob Rotterdam. German traders said demand was slight after some short-covering earlier this week.
Fuel oil talk was at around $86/$87 fob Rotterdam, as at the end of trading on Thursday. Only one trading house was bidding, although some traders said bunker demand looked healthy. --
